Sorting issues

Source: R/sort_issues.R
simple_sort.Rd

Sort issues based on quantitative variables

simple_sort(issues, sorting_variables, milestones, ...)

Arguments

issues

a IssuesTB object.

sorting_variables

a list of variable (represented by couples of object and field in the form c(object = "object_1", field = "field_1"))

milestones

a list representing milestones with simpler structure (with title, description and due_on).

...

Additional arguments passed to get_milestones. Only used if milestones is missing.

Value

the same list of issues as issues (class IssuesTB) but in a sorted order.

Examples


all_issues <- get_issues()
#> The issues will be read from /tmp/RtmpIZvBFR/data/open_issues.yaml.
all_milestones <- get_milestones()
#> The milestones will be read from /tmp/RtmpIZvBFR/data/list_milestones.yaml.

# with milestones
IssueTrackeR:::simple_sort(
    issues = all_issues,
    milestones = all_milestones,
    sorting_variables = list(
        c(object = "milestones", field = "due_on"),
        c(object = "issues", field = "created_at")
    )
)
